summary: Pricing Expansion testing completed (iteration 55). All 16 backend API tests passed for the expanded company-based pricing system. Calculator endpoints for cut_vinyl, apparel, services, custom now use tenant company settings and return full cost breakdowns including material_cost, labor_cost, overhead_cost, total_cost, selling_price, profit_amount, profit_margin_percent. Re-tested digital_print/banner, rigid_signs, vehicle_graphics - all still working correctly. Promotional calculator uses tenant settings. Job item creation preserves pricing_category and cost_snapshot fields consistently across categories. Profit calculations are internally consistent: selling_price - total_cost == profit_amount. Frontend Settings page loads with all 4 tabs (Material Costs, Labor & Overhead, Category Defaults, Selling Benchmarks) and shows expanded materials including apparel_blank, apparel_decoration, misc_material.

POST /api/pricing/calculate (cut_vinyl).description: Returns full cost breakdown with material_cost, labor_cost, overhead_cost, total_cost, selling_price, profit_amount, profit_margin_percent. Breakdown includes vinyl_type, square_feet.

POST /api/pricing/calculate (apparel).description: Returns full cost breakdown for apparel with garment_cost, decoration_cost, print_locations. Uses tenant apparel_blank and apparel_decoration material costs.

POST /api/pricing/calculate (services).description: Returns full cost breakdown for services with service_type, hourly_rate, hours. Uses tenant installer_hourly_rate and design_hourly_rate.

POST /api/pricing/calculate (custom).description: Returns full cost breakdown for custom/misc items with labor_hours, hourly_rate, overhead_cost.

POST /api/pricing/calculate (digital_pri.description: Continues to work with full cost breakdown including grommets, hemming, lamination costs.

POST /api/pricing/calculate (rigid_signs.description: Continues to work with substrate costs, laminate, and finishing costs.

POST /api/pricing/calculate (vehicle_gra.description: Continues to work with vehicle_type, coverage_type, actual_sqft, install_hours.

POST /api/pricing/calculate (promotional.description: Uses tenant settings (production_hourly_rate, overhead, markup). Returns full cost breakdown with price_per_item.

GET /api/pricing/defaults (all categorie.description: Returns category_defaults for all 7 categories: vehicle_wraps, banners, rigid_signs, cut_vinyl, apparel, services, custom. Each has default_markup_multiplier, target_profit_margin_percent.

Job item creation with cost_snapshot (cu.description: Job item created with pricing_category='cut_vinyl' and cost_snapshot containing material_cost, labor_cost, overhead_cost, total_cost, selling_price, profit, profit_margin.

Job item creation with cost_snapshot (ap.description: Job item created with pricing_category='apparel' and cost_snapshot persisted correctly.

Job item creation with cost_snapshot (se.description: Job item created with pricing_category='services' and cost_snapshot persisted correctly.

Job items persistence verification.description: All job items retrieved via GET /api/jobs/{id}/items have pricing_category and cost_snapshot fields.

Profit consistency across categories.description: All 8 calculator categories tested: selling_price - total_cost == profit_amount consistently.

Frontend Settings page loads.description: Page at /pricing-calculator/settings loads with data-testid='pricing-settings-page'. Shows 10 tracked materials, 7 reference benchmarks.

Frontend Settings 4 tabs.description: Material Costs, Labor & Overhead, Category Defaults, Selling Benchmarks tabs all present and functional.

create_pricing_result() helper properly calculates profit_amount and profit_margin_percent from selling_price - production_cost
JobItem model includes pricing_category, pricing_data, cost_snapshot, production_cost, profit_amount, profit_margin_percent fields
PricingDefaults model has comprehensive category_defaults for all 7 categories with appropriate labor fields (per_sqft vs per_unit vs per_hour)
Frontend PricingSettings.js CATEGORY_ORDER array defines all 7 categories with correct laborField and benchmarkField mappings
Frontend correctly merges server category_defaults with local defaultCategoryDefaults to ensure all categories display
